calls.name: Skyways Air Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue nearly doubled to INR1,216.53 crore on yield and volume, but management attributes much of the jump to fuel-linked pass-through; volume growth 23% is the cited driver with no capacity or capex signal.

calls.name: Suraj Estate Developers Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 10-15% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Mumbai developer with Q1 FY27 sales value up 74% to INR141 crores but collections down to INR86 crores from INR115 crores and net debt rising to INR614 crores; no supply discipline signal, just launch and leverage ramp.

calls.name: Susan Electricals India Ltd
calls.gLine: HT & MVCC share of revenue: ~15% by year-end, ~50% by end FY27 (inconsistent) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 279% to ₹95.36 Cr with PAT ₹6.39 Cr, but the transcript is internally inconsistent on HT/MVCC share (5-10% vs 10-15% vs ~50% target) and product margins, and capex is only ₹15-20 Cr against a claimed 60% capacity add.

calls.name: Puravankara Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 28% to INR1,439 cr with collections up 40%, but net debt INR2,836 cr and debt-cut target of INR700 cr is being softened by new land buys; FY27 presales guidance of INR11,200 cr held.

calls.name: Elgi Equipments Ltd
calls.gLine: Tariff/price recovery: Price correction to flow towards end of Q2 and fully in Q3
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~23% (7pts FX) and EBITDA up 28%, with growth mostly volume-led; raw material up 5-6% vs 3-4% assumed, with price correction only from late Q2 and fully in Q3.

calls.name: Amagi Media Labs Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin: 67% to 69% for this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 437 cr (+32% YoY, record) with adj. EBITDA margin 11.5% and ~31% incremental flow-through; no capacity or capex signals, and gross margin guided 67-69% with AI investment dragging.

calls.name: Shriram Properties Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 PBT margin: 8-9% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 presales of INR484 cr (+10% YoY) and Rs1,560 cr handover pipeline, but Q1 revenue only INR271 cr (+4%) with PAT INR11 cr; FY27 is back-ended and margin recovery rests on handovers.

calls.name: Surya Roshni Ltd
calls.gLine: Lighting EBITDA FY27: ~INR200 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Steel pipe volume up 21% to 2.28 lakh tons and EBITDA/ton rose to ₹4,006, but management guided FY27 EBITDA/ton ₹4,600–4,700 and company EBITDA ₹670–680 crore, implying a steep H2 ramp.

calls.name: Arman Financial Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 AUM up 36% YoY to INR2,925 crores with PAT INR45 crores, but management stresses caution, volumes below expectation and credit cost guidance of 3-3.5% not formally given.

calls.name: Singer India Ltd
calls.gLine: Appliances EBIT breakeven: next year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 57% to Rs 144.5 cr and PBT up 225%, but growth came with a steep price correction, a Rs 32 cr working-capital build and a BIS-driven import transition still ramping.
calls.top: BIS standard cutoff 12 Aug removes imports

calls.name: Indigo Paints Ltd
calls.thesis: Indigo Paints grew standalone revenue 18.7% with volumes up double digits and EBITDA margin up to 17.7%, but management says Q2 growth will be pushed harder via trade and influencer spend and gives no margin guidance.
calls.top: Capex cycle closed; no major capex for 3 years

calls.name: Fiem Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR100 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 18.6% to INR770 cr with margin flat at 13.5%, but 4-wheeler ramp pushed out a year and input-cost pressure of ~120 bps is expected to be recovered with a lag.

calls.name: Matrimony.com Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 Matchmaking billing and revenue growth: double-digit YoY (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Matchmaking EBITDA margin rose to 26.9% and PAT grew 127% YoY to Rs 19.1 crore, helped by deferred revenue from 1-year plans; Q2 guided to double-digit billing and revenue growth and similar-to-slightly-higher profit.

calls.name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: approximately INR950 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹137.1 cr (+103.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin 28.3%, but no capacity cut or discipline signal; 18,000 MVA brownfield added for FY29 with ~1,725 MVA executed in Q1 on 19,200 MVA base.

calls.name: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Hotel keys by end FY27: 3,149 keys (12 hotels, 472 keys pipeline) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hotel operator with 92% occupancy and 8% revenue growth, but PAT fell 14% on finance costs and tax regime; supply is expanding via owned capex (~Rs 1,140 cr) while ADR growth is only 2% and pressure from West Asia disruption.

calls.name: Sunrakshakk Industries India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR900-1,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 120.6% YoY to INR276.33 cr but consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 8.18% from 10.19% QoQ on raw-material and crude-linked cost pressure; management guides ~6% FY27 PAT margin and says utilisation is only 50-55%.

calls.name: Aegis Vopak Terminals Ltd
calls.gLine: Gas volume growth: at least 25% YoY every year (annual)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 12.4% to INR233.8 crore and EBITDA up 15.6% to INR179.4 crore on liquid volumes, but gas revenue fell 3.5% and management gave no numeric capacity-discipline evidence beyond a INR10,000 crore capex plan.
calls.top: Capex plan INR10,000 cr by March 2027

calls.name: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth: 20%-25% per year over 3-4 years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Wealth manager reports 24% PAT growth (ex-fair-value) to INR116 crores with 1.1 lakh crore AUM, but supply-side levers are absent and about a quarter of the FY27 guidance is a function of mark-to-market gains.
calls.top: AMC licence application approved by Board

calls.name: Synergy Green Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation of new 45,000 t: 80% for FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 utilisation of new 45,000 t capacity at 66% and PBDIT margin 7%, with FY27 guidance of 500 cr revenue (33% growth) and +300 bp margin resting on a sharp Q2-H2 ramp.

calls.name: JNK India Ltd
calls.gLine: Chemdist revenue share FY27: 10% to 15% of JNK India revenue
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 80.6% to INR 186 cr with EBITDA margin 11.8% after Chemdist JV loss; order book INR 1,801 cr, but Q1 is seasonally 10-15% of FY revenue and the Chemdist-driven margin dip plus a cancelled export order temper the read.

calls.name: Patanjali Foods Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 29% to INR11,337 cr with EBITDA margin 4.80%, but growth is largely price-led (foods pricing ~12% vs volume ~5%), no capacity signal, and staples EBITDA negative at INR-59 cr.

calls.name: Rishabh Instruments Ltd
calls.gLine: Lumel Alucast adjusted EBITDA: breakeven for full year (end FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 4.2% to INR1,983m but EEI up 34% with ~24% margin; supply-side evidence is capacity expansion (CT capacity nearly doubling, Nashik plant), not discipline, and Lumel Alucast still loss-making.

calls.name: Orient Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Annuity revenue share: 51% target in about three years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin recovery to 7.57% EBITDA on revenue of Rs 201.92 cr (+9.7% QoQ), but management gave no numeric guidance, annuity mix only 23%, and call includes unverified figures and an evasive, promotional tone.

calls.name: JSW Dulux Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 13% to 15% (FY27 onwards)
calls.thesis: Paints demand strong with ~25% volume growth, but gross margin fell to 37.4% on high-cost inventory and gross-to-net reclass, with management guiding EBITDA margin 13-15% and no capacity discipline signals.

calls.name: Max India Ltd
calls.thesis: Max India's senior-living story is execution-led, not capital-cycle led: consol revenue Rs68.6 cr (+66% YoY) but EBITDA loss Rs25 cr, with AGEasy breakeven guided only by Q4 FY27.
calls.top: Credit lines used for working capital

calls.name: IFB Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Engineering capex: INR110 crore for full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16.65% to INR 1,529 crore with PBDIT margin 5.79%, but management could not pass through commodity or forex costs, and gross margin fell about 160 bps.
calls.top: Commodity and forex not passed on

calls.name: Tube Investments of India Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone capex FY27: Rs350 Cr for TI; Rs100 Cr Shanthi Gears; Rs600-700 Cr group
calls.thesis: Standalone margins squeezed by steel inflation in Q1 FY27, with management expecting full recovery via lagged price pass-through; engineering volumes up 17% and standalone PBT down to Rs213 Cr from Rs222 Cr.
calls.top: Steel price recovery lagged, full catch-up expected

calls.name: Tata Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue $175.4M (+4.3% QoQ, +25.2% YoY cc) with EBITDA margin 16.1%; management reiterates double-digit FY27 growth but gives no supply-side (capacity or capex) signals and margin ambition is softened.

calls.name: Dev Accelerator Ltd
calls.gLine: Signed pipeline conversion: 2.31m sq ft signed for future consumption; 8,500 seats at Ahmedabad DM project (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flex-workspace operator adding capacity: 1.13m sq ft operational, 91.93% occupancy, but Q1 consolidated revenue INR 53.8 cr with leverage flattered by excluding ~INR 226 cr lease liabilities, and supply is debt-funded expansion.

calls.name: Simplex Castings Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation: at least 80% by end of FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 35% YoY to ₹60.95 cr with EBITDA margin 18.89%, but utilisation is only 50-60% and management guides to 80% only by FY28 end, with working capital days still ~100-120.
calls.top: Near-term order book ~₹150 cr+ vs ₹80-100 cr

calls.name: Midwest Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR840 crores (granite 720, quartz 100-120)
calls.thesis: Granite-led quarter with revenue up 35% YoY, but quartz Phase 1 sold only ~5,000 tons with FY27 quartz volume guidance cut from 150,000 to 120,000 tons and EBITDA margin hit by diesel.

calls.name: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: Back to 20-21% from Q3
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 turnover up 40.5% to Rs 239.5 cr but EBITDA margin fell to about 20% (vs 23% expected) on LPG and raw-material cost spikes; order book Rs 2,329 cr, 66% defence, with capex mostly deferred pending ministry approval.
calls.top: Raw-material adverse variance Rs 13 cr in Q1

calls.name: KRBL Ltd
calls.gLine: Masala annualised revenue run rate: approximately INR25 crores by end FY27 (end FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit was a record on price hikes and investment MTM gains, not sustainable; Middle East exports fell about 50% to INR244 crore while guidance was held and FY27 gross margin is pegged at about 30%.

calls.name: Man Infraconstruction Ltd
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with Q1 FY27 revenue up 8% to ₹218 cr and PAT up 29% to ₹72 cr, but Q1 pre-sales only ~₹290 cr against a ₹5,000 cr two-year target; no capacity or supply metrics apply.

calls.name: John Cockerill India Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating expenses (other expenses): slightly less than current quarter's ~INR70 crore
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue ~INR149 crore (+82% YoY) but down sequentially; order book ~INR4,500 crore consolidated after ~INR1,200 crore wins, with margins hit by early-stage project costs.

calls.name: Xtranet Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR 500+ crore, ~35-40% growth
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (EBITDA 20.59%, +855bp) came from services mix shift, not volume; revenue up only 11% with order book ~INR 373 cr and FY27 target of INR 500+ cr (35-40% growth).

calls.name: Travel Food Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Travel F&B operator grew system-wide sales 18% and PAT 35.6% on flat traffic, but LFL slowed to 0.8% (7% ex-disrupted markets) and EBITDA margin fell to 35.8% on pre-opening costs for 87 new outlets.

calls.name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 recovery-led quarter: recoveries up 151% to INR1,066 crores, but acquisitions fell to INR353 crores and standalone PAT of INR143 crores was flattered by INR120 crores of write-backs; no numeric guidance given.
calls.top: Acquisitions INR353 crores, down ~INR150 crores YoY

calls.name: BLS International Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Visa & Consular revenue growth: 12% to 15% (next year)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR 891 cr (+25%) and EBITDA INR 252 cr (+24%), but Visa application volumes were flat at 11.3 lakh and growth came from net revenue per application (+11%) rather than volume.

calls.name: Popular Vehicles and Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: INR8,200-8,300 crores (~20-25% growth)
calls.thesis: Dealership (auto retail) with reported revenue +44% to INR1,890 cr and EBITDA margin 3.8%; organic growth strong but no supply discipline signal, and capacity/acquisition growth is debt-funded with PAT still marginal.

calls.name: Shalby Ltd
calls.gLine: Hospital FY27 EBITDA margin: up to 20% for full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA flat at ₹49 cr on 11.6% revenue growth as margin fell to 14.5% from 16%; hospital standalone margin down to 18.4% from 21.6%, with management guiding to 20% for the full year without numbers on capacity.

calls.name: Awfis Space Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross seat additions FY27: 22,000 to 25,000 seats (FY27)
calls.thesis: Flex operator growing revenue 27% with occupancy flat at 76% and cash EBITDA margin only 10.1%; supply growth is mostly leased, not owned, so capital-light claims rest on lease-cost pass-through timing.

calls.name: Finkurve Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Lending yield: stabilise around 20% to 20.5%, ~50 bps uplift (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gold lender grew AUM 135% YoY but leverage rose from 0.7x to 2.9x D/E and ROA fell to 2.9%; management guides 50-60% AUM growth and yields ~20%, with gold-price-driven ticket size shrinkage and no supply-side capacity discipline discussed.
calls.top: Ticket size shrinking with gold price

calls.name: Baroda Extrusion Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue/profit growth FY27-28: 35% to 40% minimum rise
calls.thesis: Small copper extruder (~Rs 48 cr quarterly revenue, EBITDA margin ~7.7%) with a planned Rs 20-25 cr extrusion press expansion; management talk is heavy on vision and light on numbers, with volume and capacity figures that contradict each other.

calls.name: Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd
calls.thesis: Domino's LFL slowed to 2.5% in Q1FY27 with price hikes and LPG/cheese inflation absorbing margin; supply-side capex held at INR750-900 crore with supply chain investment past peak.

calls.name: BMW Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Pipes and tubes utilisation about 40.1% annualised (up from ~34% in FY26) on 0.5 Mt added capacity, rolling mill ~83.5%; EBITDA margin fell to 20.3% on fuel costs while gross margin rose to 67.9%.
calls.top: Eastern region capacity additions flagged by analyst

calls.name: Brand Concepts Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~11% but PBT loss widened; management says PC plant at 80%+ utilisation, PP plant ramping, and sees inventory cut to ~130 days, with capex pause for two years.

calls.name: Triton Valves Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ~15 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 group sales up ~38% YoY to ~186.5 cr with tax-credit-boosted PAT, but EBITDA margin compressed on copper pass-through and climate control is weak; no capacity discipline, capex raised to ~15 cr.

calls.name: Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 70% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 125% to Rs 13,457m and EBITDA margin 18.9%, but supply-side evidence is mostly capacity additions (3.5GW panels, 4GW power electronics) with utilisation of new Ratlam plant only 40-50% and a Rs 1,436m fire loss.

calls.name: MV Electrosystems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Post-IPO rail propulsion ramp from ~10 units in September to ~40/month by January on a 564-unit order book (INR989 crore); no deliveries in the prior two months, so the thesis rests on unproven execution.

calls.name: Radiant Cash Management Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: double-digit (10-12%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Radiant's standalone EBITDA margin fell to 13.5% from 15.9% on manpower costs, with price revisions of unspecified size only under IBA negotiation (targeted Q2); no capacity signal, and the cash-in-transit peer pricing remains unproven.

calls.name: Engineers India Ltd
calls.gLine: Consultancy turnover growth FY27: at least 10% growth on INR3,850 crore base
calls.thesis: Consultancy-led margin story: Q1 FY27 PBT up 55% to INR145 crore on consultancy segment profit of 24%, but turnkey revenue fell to INR302 crore from INR449 crore and order inflow was only INR514 crore against an INR8,000 crore annual target.
calls.top: Q1 order inflow only INR514 crore

calls.name: Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: 20% (plus or minus 5%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue INR218 cr (+7% YoY) and EBITDA INR45 cr, with the API core steady at 60%+ gross margin; new CDMO and injectable businesses drag INR23 cr opex and INR11 cr depreciation before revenue starts in H2.
calls.top: Capex INR200-250 cr per year for 2-3 years

calls.name: Apex Frozen Foods Ltd
calls.gLine: RTE share of volume: at least 20% in FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (EBITDA margin 12.7% vs 7.1%) came from price, not volume: realisation ~INR930/kg (+15%) while shrimp volume fell to 2,624 MT from 3,015 MT and utilisation stayed ~38%.

calls.name: Avanti Feeds Ltd
calls.gLine: Feed sales FY27 (MT): around 5,85,000 MTs (FY27)
calls.thesis: Feed volumes up sharply (Q1 FY27 feed sales 1,93,852 MT vs 1,23,725 in Q4) but feed PBT margin fell to 7.06% from ~13% as fish meal and soya prices spiked; a ~10% price hike taken in June-July is the only offset.

calls.name: Page Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +7.9% and PAT -4% on ~3 days of undelivered billing and input costs; management reiterates double-digit FY27 volume and 19-21% EBITDA margin, with a May price hike (2.2%) only partly covering input inflation.

calls.name: Brigade Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Commercial leasing CAGR: ~20% over 5-6 years (FY31)
calls.thesis: Real estate margin rebounded to 21% (from 12%) on better-margin project recognition while sales fell 5% and launches slipped; FY27 presales guidance of INR9,000 crores held despite 9.36 msf launch pipeline shortfall.

calls.name: Ashapura Minechem Ltd
calls.gLine: Bauxite EBITDA per ton: USD 5.5-6 near term (Next 1-2 quarters)
calls.thesis: Guinea bauxite volumes fell to 2.34 Mt from 3.16 Mt in Q4 as freight shock hit; EBITDA/t rose to $6.3 from $5.9, but management guides ~$6 near term and expects no capex-led supply response.
calls.top: Bauxite volumes 2.34 Mt, down from 3.16 Mt

calls.name: Sigachi Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: MCC realisation jumped to INR241/kg from INR216 but utilisation is only 76.8% and Q1 revenue of INR121 cr is far short of the INR650-675 cr guidance, which management says is unchanged.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 construction cost: Rs 1,200-1,300 cr
calls.thesis: Real estate developer with net debt near zero post ITC sale; Q1 collections Rs 713 cr (+31% YoY) but net sales only ~Rs 329 cr with no launches and cancellations; BD still lagging against Rs 10,000-15,000 cr FY27 target.
calls.top: Net debt near zero post ITC sale

calls.name: Borosil Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27 (ex other income): about 18%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 9% to INR253.6 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 14.6% from 17.8% on West Asia fuel/packaging inflation (~INR10 cr hit); price pass-through lags into Q2, and FY27 capex guided INR125–150 cr.

calls.name: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd
calls.gLine: Underlying margin after one-offs: around 12%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales Rs9,708m (+18.3% YoY on assumed comparison, +2.6% QoQ) but PBT margin ~9% on FX loss (~Rs147m) and ~Rs150m demerger IT costs; management guides 12% underlying and capacity-constrained until new Pune plant in 2028.
calls.top: Capex INR900-950cr for new Pune plant

calls.name: Can Fin Homes Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income: around 19.5% for the year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursements beat at INR 2,609 crore (+29% YoY), but rundown rose to INR 1,857 crore, so AUM growth stayed ~10.8% against a 14% FY target; spread 2.83%, NIM 3.81%.

calls.name: Natco Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Domestic volume growth: about 25% in volumes (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR794 cr from INR1,391 cr on lower Lenalidomide; margin 30.9% was lifted by a seasonal Adcock flu-season bump, and management reaffirmed ~INR750 cr PAT guidance with no supply-side change.
calls.top: Brazil revenue up 180% to INR178 cr

calls.name: Thomas Scott (India) Ltd
calls.thesis: Digital apparel retailer with no capacity-discipline signal; Q1 revenue +22% to INR 66 cr with EBITDA margin 13.07%, but growth was bought via marketing and wholesale aggregator sales, and a fire-insurance claim keeps debt elevated.
calls.top: Finance cost ~3x YoY on working capital

calls.name: Nava Ltd
calls.gLine: 100MW solar commissioning: by end of September 2026
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 record consolidated income of INR1,269 crores led by Zambia power (MEL 89.3% PLF), but Phase 2 thermal slipped to Q2 FY28 and metals sales dipped on Orissa shutdown.
calls.top: Phase 2 commissioning slips to Q2 FY28

calls.name: Brahmaputra Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Order book target by FY27 year-end: Rs 2,500 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 20.2% YoY to Rs 110.79 cr on a Rs 1,600 cr order book, but management gave no capacity or capex data and cash conversion and OCCPS overhang remain unresolved.
calls.top: Order book Rs 1,600 cr+ over 18-30 months

calls.name: Supriya Lifescience Ltd
calls.gLine: EU audit Ambernath: second half of November (Nov 2026)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 190 cr (+31% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 25% on water and solar-power costs; management reiterates Rs 1,000 cr and 33-35% margin guidance, with Rs 35 cr sales deferred and Rs 230-240 cr inventory to liquidate.

calls.name: Maximus International Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: above INR 200 crore (conservative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~52% to INR59.91 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 7.64% from 9.81% on Middle East war input costs; plant utilisation only ~45% of 50,000 KL, so supply is not the constraint.

calls.name: Belrise Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (company): mid-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 manufacturing revenue +20% YoY to INR21,979m but EBITDA margin 11.5% and mgmt offers no supply-side data; capacity expansion (four new facilities) and INR17,000m QIP deployment point to a capex-heavy, acquisition-led growth phase.
calls.top: Four new facilities ramping, fixed costs ahead of revenue

calls.name: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Legacy Sudarshan growth: 12% to 13% (FY2027)
calls.thesis: Acquired Heubach/Clariant pigment group posted business EBITDA of Rs128 Cr (6-7% margin) with guidance of EUR700m turnover and EUR35m EBITDA held, not raised, pending Q2; volume growth unclear and supply discipline not discussed.
calls.top: Working capital stretched by safety stock

calls.name: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 orders hit a record INR 915 crore but EBIT fell to INR 32 crore on commodity-driven gross margin squeeze from legacy fixed-price orders; management gave no numeric guidance and pricing actions are yet to fructify.
calls.top: Gross margin hit by legacy fixed-price orders

calls.name: PI Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: ETR: around 24% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 17,023 mn, EBITDA margin 22%, export value down 12% on 8% volume decline despite ~13% rupee tailwind; no capacity cut, capex Rs 700-800 cr held, FY27 growth guided low single digit.

calls.name: Gaja Alternative Asset Management Ltd
calls.thesis: Asset manager with 100% fee and performance economics; Q1 FY27 PAT up 35% to INR27.2 crore, but performance income (INR29.7 crore) is lumpy and management declined to give forward guidance.

calls.name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
calls.gLine: Own GPU deployment: ~1,500 GPUs by Jan/Feb 2027 (mid-to-end Q4)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7.3% YoY to INR133.66 cr with GPU capacity (Sharon AI, 8,200 B300s) not billing until Q3; the story rests on unproven GPU leasing and heavy customer-advance funding.
calls.top: Sharon AI GPU billing slipped to Q3

calls.name: Praj Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Praj GenX EBITDA breakeven: by end of FY27
calls.thesis: Praj's Q1 FY27 shows order intake of INR 10 billion and backlog of INR 45.9 billion, but first-gen ethanol greenfield slowdown, funding delays and rising material costs keep conversion and margins weak.

calls.name: Dilip Buildcon Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days year-end: about 120
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin 10.32% and order inflow only Rs 268 crores; management holds FY27 order guidance of Rs 10,000-12,000 crores and debt cut of Rs 600-800 crores, while standalone net debt rose to Rs 2,106 crores.

calls.name: Xtglobal Infotech Ltd
calls.thesis: Soft IT-services quarter: consolidated revenue +1.1% YoY to ₹93.30 cr, with EBITDA margin up to 7.6% on offshoring mix shift; no supply-side or capex content, and US public-sector and Ireland entry are early-stage.

calls.name: Rathi Steel & Power Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: 2-3% improvement over two years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up ~30% to 28,372 MT with TMT doubling, but stainless volumes fell 10-12% and EBITDA margin stays ~4%; utilisation only ~51-52% in FY26, guided >60%.

calls.name: Western Carriers (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: approx INR100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 12% to INR465 cr and PAT INR9 cr on domestic volume growth of 37%, but EXIM freight spikes, 111 working-capital days and an unchanged 4.1% EBITDA margin show pricing has not been passed through.
calls.top: EXIM freight 3-4x; no price hike discussed

calls.name: Rico Auto Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: more than INR3,200 crores (~INR3,250 cr) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~39% to INR755 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 4.6% and PAT turned to a INR3.4 cr loss on air freight and aluminium settlement lag; capex being curtailed after 54 projects.

calls.name: Vikran Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue from operations: INR2,300–2,500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 standalone revenue INR204 cr (+28%) with consolidated revenue only INR141.6 cr after NOPL consolidation; H2-weighted FY27 guide of INR2,300–2,500 cr and receivables (debtor days ~296) remain the key unproven items.

calls.name: Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Legacy inventory liquidation FY27: 40% to 60% of ~INR 75 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit spike driven by one horizontal project (Imperia Phase 2, ~60% gross margin on 85% of revenue); bookings fell to INR 105.7 cr with no supply-discipline evidence, and FY28 guidance is only qualitative.

calls.name: Tata Elxsi Ltd
calls.gLine: EBIT margin: Sequential ramp toward Q4, no numeric target
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,021 crore, up 6.5% YoY constant currency, but EBIT margin fell 330 bps QoQ on one-offs and onshore ramp costs; management guides to recovery over four quarters without a number.

calls.name: Senco Gold Ltd
calls.gLine: New stores: 12-15 more in FY27 (remainder FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 67% with retail +50% and SSSG ~39%, but reported EBITDA fell to 7.0% (from 10.1%) and management retained 7.5-7.8% guidance; supply-side signals (inventory days ~152, hedging held at ~50%) are mixed.

calls.name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Non-convenience fee: return to INR150 crore per quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.1% to INR1,370 crore led by catering (+34%), but EBITDA fell 2.8% to INR386 crore and margin dipped to 28.2% on one-offs, HR cost and a 30% resin-driven squeeze in Rail Neer; no supply-side capacity signal from IRCTC itself.

calls.name: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: Quarter-on-quarter growth similar to recent quarters (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin jumped to 16.29% (from 5.87%) on mix and efficiency, but management still guides 10–12% sustainable; utilisation 64% in FY26 while a 3,550 MTPA expansion is announced, with cost pass-through of raw materials.

calls.name: Purple Style Labs Ltd
calls.thesis: Luxury omni-channel retailer in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA at negative INR11 crores vs negative INR4 crores a year ago, PAT loss INR88 crores, and debt rising to INR436 crores despite inventory falling to INR159 crores.

calls.name: Mach Travel Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR144.33 cr (+538% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 6.09% from 7.17%, management admits markup cuts for aggressive market share and working-capital strain requires bank OD.
calls.top: Working capital strain, bank OD being sought

calls.name: Ceinsys Tech Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue flat at INR158 crore (+1% YoY) with margin up to 24.4%; order book INR990 crore but management refused all forward guidance and UBR/cash conversion remains weak (164-day working capital cycle).

calls.name: Brainbees Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin recovery: fully recover crude/rupee pass-through by end of Q2
calls.thesis: India multi-channel revenue grew 17.7% but gross margin fell 280 bps in Q4 and recovered only 20 bps in Q1, with diapering price competition and crude-linked pass-through driving the squeeze; consolidated adj. EBITDA margin fell to 4.24% from 4.98%.
calls.top: India gross margin down 280 bps in Q4

calls.name: Premier Explosives Ltd
calls.gLine: Export revenue Q2: INR150-200 crores (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 28% to INR102.6 cr and EBIT margin to 4.7% on export and import delays; order book INR1,393 cr (94% defence) and FY27 INR600 cr target rests on export licences arriving, with no new capacity capex quantified.

calls.name: Highway Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 turnover: INR 850 crore (INR 700 crore toll, rest EPC) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA just INR 4.8 crore and PAT INR 1.1 crore on toll traffic hit; management guides FY27 turnover INR 850 crore with no supply-side or capex disclosure, so the read is weak and unverified.
calls.top: Q1 EBITDA INR 4.8 crore, PAT INR 1.1 crore

calls.name: Indogulf Cropsciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak revenue with existing capacity: Rs 1100-1200 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 11% YoY to Rs 168.5 cr on monsoon-delayed demand and price pressure, while gross margin rose to 28% from 22%; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and finance costs rose ~19%.
calls.top: Prices under pressure, China supply elevated

calls.name: NIS Management Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 consolidated revenue: INR630-640 crores, crossing INR650 crores (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 total income up 15.7% to INR115.44 cr with EBITDA margin 7.99% (+121 bps), but capital-cycle signals are thin: no capacity or capex discipline evidence, management reiterates INR500 cr FY27 and INR650 cr FY28 targets, and rejects a buyback.

calls.name: Virat Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Lord Walker domestic volume: approximately 1 million pairs in calendar 2027 (CY2027)
calls.thesis: Investor-meet call is mostly promoter-led diversification into a Brahm lifestyle platform via Rs95 cr primary investment; socks pricing up to Rs63/pair but no capacity, utilisation or capex disclosure, and forecasts are unsupported.
calls.top: Rs95 cr primary investment in lifestyle unit

calls.name: Prime Fresh Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 7% to 7.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 15.7% to INR81.71 crores and EBITDA margin 9.83%, but management itself flagged one-offs, guides EBITDA 7-7.5%, and receivables are about a third of sales with INR7-8 crore slow-moving debtors.

calls.name: VMS TMT Ltd
calls.gLine: Sales growth: 10% to 15% annually (annual)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% y/y to INR247.88 cr but EBITDA fell about 41% on imported scrap cost and forex; TMT utilisation near 80%, with management guiding margin recovery only from Q3.
calls.top: EBITDA down ~41% y/y on scrap costs

calls.name: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak revenue FY28: exceeding 1100 crore (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit spike (PAT +79% to ₹18.57 cr) is partly one-off: management says ~50% came from inventory gains and called the quarter "special"; R32 plant slipped from Dec-26 target and FY27 contribution cut from ₹250 cr, with new equity/debt raise now under consideration.

calls.name: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd
calls.gLine: Bajaj Finance retail financing share: 15% to 20% of retail this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 11% to ₹313.4 cr but operational EBITDA margin fell ~45bp to 12.85% on raw-material inflation; tractor volumes weak and FY27 outlook explicitly withheld.

calls.name: Skipper Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 order inflow: INR7,000 crores plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Skipper Q1 FY27 revenue +4.5% to INR1,310 cr with exports weak and 75,000 t capacity slipping to H2; reiterates 15% FY27 growth and INR7,000 cr order inflow, which needs a sharp H2 ramp.

calls.name: Petronet LNG Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 and FY28 capex: INR 9,064 crore FY27; similar for FY28
calls.thesis: Petronet's Q1 FY27 profit rose 33% on trading and inventory gains (INR 301 cr and INR 193 cr) while Dahej utilisation fell to 66% on an expanded 22.5 MMTPA base, with Qatar force majeure still in place.
calls.top: Dahej utilisation 66% vs 92% a year ago

calls.name: JSW Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: North EBITDA breakeven: Q2 FY27 at EBITDA level (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up 15% to 3.81Mt with North ramp, but consolidated EBITDA fell 7.5% YoY to INR299cr on fuel costs and INR33cr North marketing; North utilisation 55%, company guides high-teens FY27 volume growth.
calls.top: GGBS growth cut to high single digits

calls.name: EMS Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs 900-950 crore (at par with FY25) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue Rs 125.72 cr (+50% QoQ) on fixed-cost civil EPC; management guides FY27 revenue ~Rs 900-950 cr with Q4 strongest, but no capacity or capex signal and margins rely on a back-ended ramp.

calls.name: Maan Aluminium Ltd
calls.gLine: Pithampur Italian line contribution: significant contribution by mid of next year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR232 cr (+10% YoY, -9% QoQ) with EBITDA INR7 cr (~3% margin); volumes flat at ~1,558 t, export share down from 60-70% to 45% on duties, and capex back-ended.

calls.name: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: US growth: 8-10% (about 8% by year end)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,898m (+2% YoY, -7% QoQ) and EBITDA margin fell to 27% from 30%; management guides ~30-32% margin and double-digit growth for the year, with US growth only 8-10%. No supply-side discipline signal.

calls.name: Religare Enterprises Ltd
calls.thesis: Religare's insurance arm Care grew GWP 37% with combined ratio 102.6% and RBI rejected the demerger, so value unlock is stalled while Care's solvency sits at 1.58% against a 1.7x target.

calls.name: Kilburn Engineering Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue ~INR117 crore with 20.1% EBITDA margin, but FY27 INR700 crore guidance held on an H2-weighted assumption with only ~INR485 crore closing order book and 3-4 projects slipping.
calls.top: FY27 INR700 cr held despite Q1 INR117 cr

calls.name: EID Parry India Ltd
calls.gLine: CPG quarterly breakeven: 4-5 quarters
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sugar crush fell to 1.47 LMT from 2.12 LMT as TN/AP cane supply shrinks, with PSRIPL refinery shut and Rs 665 crore infused; the quarter is seasonally weak and the fix is still a plan.

calls.name: Shankesh Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume outlook / margin range: none quantified
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 55% YoY to INR424 cr with EBITDA margin ~14%, but management attributed margin gains to mix without quantification, volumes flat, and no capacity or capex discipline evidence.

calls.name: Max Estates Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales Rs 1,100 cr (5x YoY) with Rs 13,500 cr contracted portfolio, but management withdrew sales guidance and consol PBT was only Rs 11 cr, so the read is cash-backed pipeline rather than hard earnings.

calls.name: Cochin Shipyard Ltd
calls.gLine: Blended EBITDA margin: ~14% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT fell to INR 151.45 crores from 187.82 crores while management guides ~12% revenue growth and 14% blended EBITDA, with capex rising to ~INR 6,000-6,500 crores across ISRF JV, Vadinar, BF and Tuticorin projects.
calls.top: Operating cash flow negative in FY26

calls.name: DCW Ltd
calls.gLine: Basic Chemicals breakeven: breakeven in Q2 if normalcy holds
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PVC disruption drove Basic Chemicals EBITDA to -INR14 crore, while Specialty EBITDA rose ~20% YoY; management now frames steady-state EBITDA at ~INR300 crore versus prior INR400 crore target.
calls.top: Basic Chem EBITDA negative INR14 crore

calls.name: Globe Civil Projects Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27 on existing order book: 10% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: EPC civil contractor reports Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin ~17% and PAT up 40%, but receivables and inventory rose faster than revenue and management guides only 10-15% growth on a ~INR700 crore order book.
calls.top: Receivables and inventory up in FY26

calls.name: KSB Ltd
calls.thesis: H1 FY27 sales were subdued, up only 2-3% on export delays, solar slippage and supply-chain issues, with management still aiming for double-digit FY27 growth and valves EBITDA margin in single digits.

calls.name: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 376.6 cr (+85% YoY) with EBITDA margin ~9.3% flat QoQ; compressor utilisation only ~50% and AC capacity 1.0→1.8m sets with 50-60% FY28 utilisation planned, so capacity additions outrun demand visibility.

calls.name: Orchid Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: Jammu 7-ACA ramp-up: 80% to 100% utilisation by end of first year (first year post start)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR304 crore (+15% YoY) and gross margin 33% (from 30%), but management calls the industry overcapacitated with cutthroat competition and gives no FY27 numeric guidance.

calls.name: Dhruv Consultancy Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR15.55 cr with operating loss ~INR3 cr; management calls it a paper correction and says a INR300 cr unexecuted order book converts over ~3 years, with billing only from Q3 and no numeric guidance.
calls.top: Q1 operating loss ~INR3 cr on INR15.55 cr sales

calls.name: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd
calls.gLine: DICE revenue: INR15-16 cr FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Zaggle Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 28% to INR423 cr but adjusted EBITDA margin fell to 8.2% from 10.1% as capitalisation was reversed into P&L; cash-flow fix is a 15-18 month story with no numbers.
calls.top: Capitalisation moderated, costs pushed to P&L

calls.name: Fino Payments Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Net interest margin for SFB: 8% to 9% (post-SFB)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 was weak: EBITDA fell to INR 43.1 crores from INR 56 crores in Q4 FY26 after the UPI P2M B2B pause, with throughput down 10% year-on-year and no B2B relaunch before Q4 FY27.

calls.name: Dreamfolks Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR39 crore from INR52.6 crore QoQ and INR348.9 crore YoY, with adjusted EBITDA at negative INR16.4 crore; management pins the drop on Middle East war and targets breakeven by next year, with no capacity or capex signal.

calls.name: Dynacons Systems & Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR313 cr from INR328 cr (about -5% YoY) blamed on OEM lead-times; order book ~INR3,104 cr is claimed but no supply-side or capex-discipline evidence, and management gave no numbers on recovery.

calls.name: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28-29 revenue growth: more than 10% YoY; EBITDA margin closer to 25-26% (FY28-FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 4% to INR 6,776m and EBITDA to INR 600m on a deferred order; management guides single-digit FY27 growth, with capacity utilisation and capex not discussed.

calls.name: Gem Aromatics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 3.3% and PAT was a Rs7.9 cr loss as new Dahej capacity sits idle ahead of commercial ramp; management gave no FY27 numbers, deferring guidance to calendar year-end.
calls.top: Dahej capex ~Rs265 cr of Rs270 cr capitalised

calls.name: Stanley Lifestyles Ltd
calls.gLine: Same-store growth for mature stores: 15% to 20% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR 9,935 lakhs from 10,861 (about -8.5%) on B2B freight disruption and delayed residential handovers; utilisation 68-70% and store network being reshaped, with no capacity addition signalled.

calls.name: Vascon Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Real estate annual booking value: INR1,200-1,500 crores by FY31 (FY31)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue fell to INR152 crores from INR221 crores on EPC execution stalls from client cash-flow issues; management still targets INR1,200 crores FY27 revenue with Q3–Q4 weighted, a back-loaded claim that Q1 execution does not yet support.

calls.name: Kaveri Seed Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Cash on books at Q2 end: close to Rs 300 cr (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to Rs 815 cr (from 945) on El Nino-hit Kharif, with inventory up ~Rs 200 cr and management promising lower production next year; cotton margins at ~15% EBITDA.

calls.name: VA Tech Wabag Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 13% to 14% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR 887 crore (+20.8% YoY) and order book INR 19,400 crore (over 4x revenue), but EBITDA margin is guided only 13-15% and capex is not a constraint since the model is asset-light.

calls.name: Laxmi India Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth: ~28% growth
calls.thesis: Secured MSME NBFC growing AUM 27% YoY to ₹1,721 crore with 2.08% GNPA, but ~0.83% ex-Upmoney; guidance ~28% growth and ~22–25bp further borrowing-cost cut.

calls.name: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Ltd
calls.gLine: Motor OD loss ratio target: below 80% over time; immediate goal high-70s
calls.thesis: Chola MS general insurance Q1 FY27: GWP up 6.7% to Rs 2,130 cr, combined ratio 120.4% with motor OD loss ratio elevated (80-86%) and no clear recovery timeline; industry fire pricing still soft.

calls.name: Jungle Camps India Ltd
calls.gLine: Mathura hotel opening: FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Small wildlife-camp operator with flat-ish ADR (+5% YoY) and occupancy 45% in Q1 FY27; EBITDA fell to 27% from 32% and growth depends on debt-funded Mathura and Sheopur projects, a weak supply-side signal.
calls.top: New capacity debt-funded: ₹32 cr HDFC loan

calls.name: Rhi Magnesita India Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin gain (EBITDA 14.5% vs 10.8%) rests on price and mix with no capacity signal; capex run-rate at INR8 crore vs INR150 crore guide is unexplained, and management reiterated 13% margin and 7-8% volume guidance.

calls.name: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM target: INR1,600-1,700 crores for profitability inflection (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 MFI-to-secured pivot: disbursements fell to INR77 crores from INR92 crores, NIM fell to 12.3% from 14.36%, and PAT was INR0.21 crores, with a Q4 FY27 normalisation promised but unproven.

calls.name: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 turnover: Rs 1,250 cr, possibly Rs 1,350-1,400 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs 280 cr on 25% lower chemical volumes and fertiliser volume down 13%; management guides FY27 Rs 1,250 cr (possibly 1,350-1,400) while Unit 5/6 capacity is added and acid plants are run at low load.

calls.name: Foods & Inns Ltd
calls.gLine: Frozen segment revenue: USD30-plus million in 3 years; 20%-plus growth this year (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 exports slowed by vessel shortage and freight spikes with delayed call-offs but no cancellations; frozen segment grew about 20% in Q1 and management sees domestic volume growth of 20%.

calls.name: Transpek Industry Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: at least 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 6.5% to INR155.1 cr and EBITDA fell 32.4% to INR24.1 cr (15.6% margin); management guides ~15% FY27 revenue growth and a INR250 cr Odisha/pilot capex plan, with the key DuPont/Arclin contract renewal unresolved.

calls.name: Ion Exchange India Ltd
calls.gLine: Specialty chemicals capacity: At least 50% increase over next couple of years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell 49% YoY to INR 32 crore (4.54% margin) as Treatment Solutions stayed loss-making on legacy UP project; Roha capacity ramp is slower than the 25% first-year utilisation guided.

calls.name: Yatra Online Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gross bookings up 17% to INR21,007m but adjusted EBITDA fell 39% to INR151m (12.3% of gross margin) on MICE disruption and Kanoo cost build; management gives no FY27 guidance and expects only a H2 recovery.

calls.name: Patel Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: New stores FY27: 8 to 10 stores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to about 6.3% from prior levels on raw-material mix, with capacity utilisation only 50–55% and a 24-month store payback; supply discipline is not evidenced.

calls.name: Kusumgar Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: similar to FY25-FY26 levels, moving a few percentage points (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR247.2 cr (+102% YoY, -21% QoQ) with management declining formal guidance and order-book disclosure; utilisation only 55-60% with no large capex planned, so supply is not yet a constraint.

calls.name: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd
calls.gLine: Same-store revenue growth FY27: mid-single-digit
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 5% to INR125.3 cr with EBITDA margin down to 21.2% and PAT 1.8%, as marketing rose to 8.5% of revenue; management gave no numeric growth visibility beyond the next few quarters.

calls.name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% against 20-30% expected, PAT down to INR95 crore from INR111 crore as depreciation and interest hit before IPP revenue ramps; margins under geopolitical cost pressure at KP Energy.
calls.top: PAT margin FY27 guide to be lower

calls.name: Rupa & Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Athleisure growth FY27: more than double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +10.1% to Rs 202.4 cr on volume, but price hikes of 4-5% were passed on as schemes; EBITDA margin 7.8% missed the prior 9-10% guide, with guidance reiterated at 9-10% for next quarter.
calls.top: Q1 price hike 4-5% passed to trade

calls.name: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Kharsang gas pipeline: 24 km, completion by December next year (Dec 2027)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue rebounded to INR117.5 cr standalone on Kharsang volumes and $95.5/bbl realisation, but B-80 output is down on water cut, HPCL crude stuck and funding for the three-well B-80 programme depends on raising debt.

calls.name: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR6,000 to 8,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue flat at INR1,320 crores, FY27 growth guide cut from 20% to 10-15% and margin guide cut 0.5pt, with domestic highway awarding muted and order book INR15,251 crores.

calls.name: Krsnaa Diagnostics Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA positive: Q2 FY27
calls.thesis: Krsnaa Q1 FY27 revenue up 22% to INR2,355m but EBITDA margin fell to 25% from 27% on Rajasthan ramp costs; management guides EBITDA-positive by Q2 with no hard numeric margin guidance, and receivables from Himachal and Karnataka remain uncollected.

calls.name: Shilchar Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 business momentum: notably better than Q1
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 134.6 cr and EBITDA Rs 29.2 cr hit by West Asia shipping costs and delayed pass-through; utilisation only 60-65% in Q1, with 7,500 MVA existing capacity guided to near-full use and Phase-3 (6,500 MVA) on track for April 2027.

calls.name: Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: ICONIQA annualised revenue break-even: ~INR 85 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 36% to ~INR 107 cr and EBITDA margin ~30.7%, but PAT fell to ~INR 6.4 cr from 10.9 cr; management concedes profit is flat and ICONIQA break-even needs ~INR 85 cr annualised revenue.

calls.name: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Cell ramp-up / utilisation: about 80% utilisation by Q4 FY27 (Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume collapsed to 334 MW sales (from 1,050 MW in Q4) and EBITDA fell to INR 425 mn; capex of ~INR 1,000 mn spent with cell ramp only from Sept, so supply discipline is offset by weak utilisation and no cell output until late FY27.

calls.name: BCL Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Distillery and overall EBITDA margin: around 10% - 12%
calls.thesis: Distillery margin rose to 12.41% but ENA realisation fell to INR58/l from INR70 on oversupply, with the 200 KLPD plant shut after a fire and the 250 KLPD Fatehabad expansion put on hold.

calls.name: AJC Jewel Manufacturers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 standalone India revenue: Rs 450 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 125% to Rs 101.4 cr with EBITDA margin 4.6%, but management gave no utilisation or capex-cut discipline, Kerala capacity being expanded to 120% while utilisation is ~25%, and CFO has been negative for six years.

calls.name: Jinkushal Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 15.9% to INR56.57 cr but PAT fell to INR2.2 cr from INR6.51 cr, with INR96.8 cr inventory (INR84.4 cr overseas) and no supply discipline signal, so this is a cash-stretched growth read.
calls.top: Inventory INR96.8 cr, INR84.4 cr overseas

calls.name: ECOS (India) Mobility & Hospitality Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 10.3% (from 12.0% a year ago) on ETS price competition; FY27 margin guidance cut to around 10% from 11–13%, while revenue guidance held at 15–18%.

calls.name: KNR Constructions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR2,200–2,300 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA of 15% was flattered by a one-off ~INR46 crore cash-surplus claim; ex-one-off margin ~5.5%, with receivables stretched (Telangana ~INR1,300 crore) and FY27 revenue guided INR2,200–2,300 crore.

calls.name: Pyramid Technoplast Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation: 70% overall by year end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Utilisation at 62% on 20,936 MT capacity with volumes of 1,292 MT, while revenue rose 36% on price pass-through; management guides FY27 utilisation to 70% and EBITDA margin above 10%.
calls.top: Polymer drum price Rs160 → Rs140 expected

calls.name: Som Distilleries & Breweries Ltd
calls.gLine: Andhra Pradesh go-live: first week of September
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 was a disrupted quarter: MP brewery suspended ~6 months, ~INR250-260 crore revenue lost, EBITDA INR15.2 crore; UP brewery (10m cases) commissioned but management guides FY27 revenue down to INR1,000-1,100 crore.

calls.name: Ardee Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line growth: 10% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 35% YoY to Rs 338.8 cr on 17,645 MT volume, but EBITDA flat at Rs 33.8 cr with margin ~10%; capacity expanded 50.9% to 1,56,950 MTPA yet utilisation guided lower at 65% and FY27 volume growth 10-20%.

calls.name: India Pesticides Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line growth: lower single-digit growth (FY27)

calls.name: Solex Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 module utilisation assumption: around 55% (FY27)

calls.name: K.P. Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: IPP capacity by end FY27: 100 MW (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~126% to Rs 521 cr but gross margin fell to ~20% from 28% in Q4; order book cut to Rs 2,250 cr and FY27 growth guided to 30-40%, with no margin guidance.

calls.name: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Central Vista billing FY27: INR700 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 4.29% from 8.59% on AIIMS Jammu bill cut (2.6pp), NCR labour wage hikes and staff costs; double-digit margin for FY27 ruled out and inflow guidance cut.

calls.name: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days March 2027: 120-150 days
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 76 cr (+38% YoY) with EBITDA margin 8.55%, but operating cash flow still negative (INR 16 cr), receivables INR 231 cr, and the Jhajjar BESS plant is delayed to H1 with FY27 utilisation capped at 20-25%.

calls.name: SRG Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Business recovery: Q2 slowdown, Q3 and Q4 good
calls.thesis: Management denies a Rs 400 crore siphoning report and says NHB red-flagged the account with no reasons given; disbursements slowed, credit rating under watch, and no audit findings disclosed on a Rs 1,100 crore book.

firstTimers.name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹137.1 cr (+103.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin 28.3%, but no capacity cut or discipline signal; 18,000 MVA brownfield added for FY29 with ~1,725 MVA executed in Q1 on 19,200 MVA base.

firstTimers.name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 recovery-led quarter: recoveries up 151% to INR1,066 crores, but acquisitions fell to INR353 crores and standalone PAT of INR143 crores was flattered by INR120 crores of write-backs; no numeric guidance given.

firstTimers.name: Glass Wall Systems (India) Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Facade maker's first call: Q1 revenue Rs.107 cr (+36% YoY) and EBITDA margin 21.3%, with FY27 guidance of ~25% growth, 23-25% EBITDA margin and Rs.982 cr order book, but no capacity discipline data and a loose order-inflow answer.

firstTimers.name: Steamhouse India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Steam volumes up 16.7% YoY with utilisation 41.40% (from 36.06%) and EBITDA/ton ₹1,011, but ~70% of 345 TPH is contracted and capacity is being added toward 705 TPH.

firstTimers.name: Purple Style Labs Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Luxury omni-channel retailer in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA at negative INR11 crores vs negative INR4 crores a year ago, PAT loss INR88 crores, and debt rising to INR436 crores despite inventory falling to INR159 crores.

firstTimers.name: Prasol Chemicals Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA INR90.3 cr (20.8% margin) was flattered by ~INR25 cr inventory gain in a price spike; management guides FY27 adjusted EBITDA INR240-250 cr ex-gain, with Phase 1 capex of INR250-300 cr adding ~60,000 t.

firstTimers.name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7.3% YoY to INR133.66 cr with GPU capacity (Sharon AI, 8,200 B300s) not billing until Q3; the story rests on unproven GPU leasing and heavy customer-advance funding.

firstTimers.name: Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue INR218 cr (+7% YoY) and EBITDA INR45 cr, with the API core steady at 60%+ gross margin; new CDMO and injectable businesses drag INR23 cr opex and INR11 cr depreciation before revenue starts in H2.

firstTimers.name: Hy-Tech Engineers Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR430m but EBITDA margin fell to 19.6% from 21.5%; management attributes it to price pass-through lagging into Q2 and guides ~20% growth and 24-25% margin, with capacity at 60-70% utilisation.

firstTimers.name: Skyways Air Services Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue nearly doubled to INR1,216.53 crore on yield and volume, but management attributes much of the jump to fuel-linked pass-through; volume growth 23% is the cited driver with no capacity or capex signal.

firstTimers.name: Tempsens Instruments (India) Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 33% to INR118 crores, but EBITDA margin fell to 22% from 25.3%; management guides growth in line with the 3-year blend and ~INR500 crores of capacity coming online by Q3 FY28, with utilisation at about 80%.

firstTimers.name: Gaja Alternative Asset Management Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Asset manager with 100% fee and performance economics; Q1 FY27 PAT up 35% to INR27.2 crore, but performance income (INR29.7 crore) is lumpy and management declined to give forward guidance.

firstTimers.name: Shankesh Jewellers Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 55% YoY to INR424 cr with EBITDA margin ~14%, but management attributed margin gains to mix without quantification, volumes flat, and no capacity or capex discipline evidence.

firstTimers.name: Novartis India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Post-takeover Novartis India is rebuilding its commercial model: M&A-led growth, ~INR40–50 crore extra quarterly costs from Q2 and a margin dip, with no supply-side capacity signal.

firstTimers.name: AJC Jewel Manufacturers Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 125% to Rs 101.4 cr with EBITDA margin 4.6%, but management gave no utilisation or capex-cut discipline, Kerala capacity being expanded to 120% while utilisation is ~25%, and CFO has been negative for six years.

firstTimers.name: Horizon Industrial Parks Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Industrial REIT-style platform with 29.5 mn sq ft operational, Q1 revenue INR200 cr (+23%) and 12% re-leasing spreads, but reported net loss of INR12 cr and no capacity-discipline evidence; supply is self-driven expansion, not industry-wide.

firstTimers.name: Molbio Diagnostics Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Molbio's Truenat point-of-care platform is capacity-rich (kits at 58%, devices at 42% utilisation) with guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 24–25% EBITDA; no prior guidance was supplied to check against.

firstTimers.name: Shiprocket Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Asset-light shipping and D2C enabler: core transactions +31% with core EBITDA margin 12.8% (+50bps YoY) and emerging EBITDA improving to -24% from -38%, but no capex or supply lever to read.

firstTimers.name: Behari Lal Engineering Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin expansion came from mix (high-value 60.4% of revenue, EBITDA/ton ~13,500), but melt capacity is unchanged until Unit 3 next year, with FY27 capex of INR80 crore (only INR5 crore spent in Q1).

firstTimers.name: Dhoot Transmission Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue growth near 50% YoY with EBITDA margin up 110bp to 15%, but management guides 15-16% margin only as copper pass-through lags; no capacity-discipline signal beyond 15-20% expansion at two plants.

firstTimers.name: Milky Mist Dairy Food Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR973 crore with EBITDA margin 14.9% vs 12.2% a year ago; growth led by paneer, yogurt and ice cream, with capacity still underutilised (~50% per analyst) and no supply-side discipline signal.

firstTimers.name: LEAP India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Pallet pooling leader LEAP grows revenue 19% and EBITDA 21% in Q1 FY27 while trimming asset capex to INR76 crore from INR110 crore, with utilisation up to 89.2% and no new capacity push.

firstTimers.name: Ardee Industries Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 35% YoY to Rs 338.8 cr on 17,645 MT volume, but EBITDA flat at Rs 33.8 cr with margin ~10%; capacity expanded 50.9% to 1,56,950 MTPA yet utilisation guided lower at 65% and FY27 volume growth 10-20%.

firstTimers.name: Juniper Green Energy Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with 601 MW commissioned and CUF 30.2%, but no capacity cuts or utilisation tailwind; the story is contracted build-out and a BESS-led pivot, with tariffs and EBITDA guidance that depend on execution.

firstTimers.name: MV Electrosystems Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Post-IPO rail propulsion ramp from ~10 units in September to ~40/month by January on a 564-unit order book (INR989 crore); no deliveries in the prior two months, so the thesis rests on unproven execution.

firstTimers.name: Lohia Corp Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Woven-plastic machinery maker reported Q1 FY27 revenue INR503 cr (+60% YoY) and EBITDA margin 19.9%, with order book ~INR1,778 cr (+30% QoQ) and utilisation of 70-75%, but no capacity added yet.

firstTimers.name: Maximus International Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~52% to INR59.91 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 7.64% from 9.81% on Middle East war input costs; plant utilisation only ~45% of 50,000 KL, so supply is not the constraint.

firstTimers.name: Virat Industries Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Investor-meet call is mostly promoter-led diversification into a Brahm lifestyle platform via Rs95 cr primary investment; socks pricing up to Rs63/pair but no capacity, utilisation or capex disclosure, and forecasts are unsupported.

firstTimers.name: Xtranet Technologies Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (EBITDA 20.59%, +855bp) came from services mix shift, not volume; revenue up only 11% with order book ~INR 373 cr and FY27 target of INR 500+ cr (35-40% growth).

firstTimers.name: Solex Energy Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 1.8% to INR265.6 crore and PAT margin fell to 3.1% as ALMM-2 delays pushed module offtake into H2; FY27 guidance held at 5-6% PAT margin with 55% utilisation assumed.

firstTimers.name: Allcargo Global Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA turned to INR33 crore from a INR17 crore Q4 and a loss last year, but volumes are still below prior levels and management gave no hard numbers beyond a flat dollar cost intent.

firstTimers.name: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Platform premium up 49% to INR 1,204 crores and service EBITDA up 89% to INR 39 crores (13% of revenue), but no capacity or supply-side metric; growth is volume and renewal driven.

firstTimers.name: Flomic Global Logistics Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.4% to INR120 cr and EBITDA margin up 275bp to 9.34%, but management attributes most growth to freight rates (volume only +6-7%) and gives no capacity or capex data, so the read is cyclical freight-rate tailwind rather than supply-side evidence.

firstTimers.name: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 22.7% to INR85.2 cr and EBITDA margin up to 10.14% from 7.35%, but growth is export-led; the new Andheri plant adds capacity with domestic sales still mostly unproven.

firstTimers.name: Hexagon Nutrition Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +43% to INR104.3 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 11.3% from 13.8% on raw-material and freight costs; capacity utilisation rose to 47% from ~30%, while inventory days climbed to ~142 from ~130.

firstTimers.name: Baroda Extrusion Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Small copper extruder (~Rs 48 cr quarterly revenue, EBITDA margin ~7.7%) with a planned Rs 20-25 cr extrusion press expansion; management talk is heavy on vision and light on numbers, with volume and capacity figures that contradict each other.

firstTimers.name: Kusumgar Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR247.2 cr (+102% YoY, -21% QoQ) with management declining formal guidance and order-book disclosure; utilisation only 55-60% with no large capex planned, so supply is not yet a constraint.
